song_segment.name: Remembered presence
lyric_scope: Aprendí tu rostro a la luz del farol
tu voz bajo la lluvia de verano.
Y cada camino que me llevó lejos

narrative_goal: Make memory personal and intimate without jumping to the later ancestral climax: remembered woman in place, physical letter/relic, twilight memory-space, then a chapel/ruin image that closes the return motif.

selected_shots.lyric_cue: Aprendí tu rostro a la luz del farol
selected_shots.intent: Human memory becomes intimate while the harbor/fort remains legible.

selected_shots.lyric_cue: tu voz bajo la lluvia de verano.
selected_shots.intent: Letter/relic carries remembered voice and distance without adding new mythology.

selected_shots.lyric_cue: Y cada camino que me llevó lejos
selected_shots.intent: Twilight fort becomes the route-away image; retain geography and hero continuity.
Close on the memory/chapel space as a visual return, preparing the chorus without using the full ancestral convergence yet.

next_step: Stop at pre-FX. Batch 04 is ready for FX gate/review only.
